faqs.question: What is a good first WhatsApp message to a real estate lead?
faqs.answer: Introduce yourself and your company, thank them for asking about the specific project, and end with one easy question, such as whether they want a 2 or 3 BHK for themselves or as an investment. Send it within minutes of the lead arriving, before they hear from other projects.

faqs.question: Can I send WhatsApp messages to people who have not contacted me?
faqs.answer: No. Meta's opt-in rules require that the person gave you their number and agreed to receive messages from your named business. Cold messages to bought lists get blocked and reported, which lowers your quality rating and can restrict your account and messaging limits.

faqs.question: Do WhatsApp messages about a project need the RERA number?
faqs.answer: Section 11(2) of the RERA Act requires every advertisement for a registered project to show its registration number and the RERA website address. Treat any WhatsApp broadcast or message that promotes a project as an advertisement and include both details.

faqs.question: How many follow-up messages should I send on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Plan three follow-ups spaced a few days apart, each adding something new: useful information, then an answer to a common worry, then a polite message asking whether to close the enquiry. Stop at once if the buyer says no, and log the answer in your CRM.

faqs.question: What should a site visit reminder message say?
faqs.answer: Send a confirmation right after the buyer agrees, with date, time and map link. Send a reminder the evening before that asks whether the family is joining, and a short message on the morning of the visit with the time, parking point and your number.

faqs.question: How do I save these templates in the WhatsApp Business app?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings, then Business tools, then Quick replies, and save each template with a shortcut such as /first or /visit. Type / in a chat to insert one. Also set a greeting message, an away message, and labels such as New lead and Visit booked.

faqs.question: What is the 24-hour window in the WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: When a buyer messages you, you can reply freely for 24 hours, and each new message from them resets it. To message them after that window, for example a follow-up three days later, you must use a message template that Meta has approved.

faqs.question: What are the most common WhatsApp mistakes in real estate sales?
faqs.answer: Replying the next day, sending long paragraphs or voice notes to new leads, copy-paste blasts that start with Dear Sir/Madam, claims you cannot prove such as guaranteed returns, and keeping replies only on one salesperson's phone instead of a shared record.
